prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity image concept for the Arcade app inside the SPDEV OS personal portfolio.
Primary request: Design concept B, a retro multi-game console launcher with a vertical 8-bit selection menu and a big live-preview-style pane. The player scrolls up and down through one highlighted option and presses start. Produce one finished landscape 16:10 UI mockup, flat straight-on screenshot of a desktop app, filling the image. This is a believable web interface, not a photo of a TV or console in a room.
Scene/backdrop: dark charcoal app window, slim near-black titlebar "Arcade", small monochrome window controls. Inside, a beautifully proportioned graphite CRT bezel framing the usable launcher. A subtle warm-gray inner bevel and a tiny red power indicator suggest old console hardware. Screen background almost black with extremely subtle static scanlines and edge shading, keeping all text legible. Restrained crimson red is the focus color, ivory is text.
Composition: top of the inner screen reads "SPDEV ARCADE" in confident ivory 8-bit lettering, with small "SELECT YOUR GAME" underneath. Below, use an asymmetric two-column layout. Left 40 percent: a large easy-to-read vertical game list in exact order "ASTEROIDS", "SNAKE", "BREAKOUT", "LIGHTS OUT", "PIXEL STUDIO", "BEAT LAB", "GRAVITY SLING", "PRISM RELAY". ASTEROIDS is the single selected row, a strong solid crimson rectangular band with an ivory pixel arrow on its left. All other items are unboxed and quieter ivory-gray type, with comfortable row spacing. No file-system or code text.
Right 60 percent: a large striking pixel-art gameplay preview for Asteroids, showing ivory outlined asteroids, one small triangular ship, a few laser dots and crimson thrust in an open black space field. An understated block border and tiny "PREVIEW" label; no fake scores. Directly underneath: the selected title "ASTEROIDS", "Pilot your ship. Clear the field.", a red rectangular "START GAME" action.
Across the bottom of the screen: a short key legend with up/down arrows "SELECT", enter key "START", escape key "BACK"; small "01 / 08" at the far right. Keep the main preview visually larger than the menu and maintain clean safe margins.
Style/medium: authentic late-1980s console menu with modern typography discipline, legible pixel font, measured 8-bit borders, restrained soft CRT phosphor, premium finish. Visual nostalgia comes from menu geometry, pixel forms, scanlines and plastic bezel, not busy decoration. Dark charcoal, warm gray, ivory and crimson. Pixel-art preview should feel authored rather than generic.
Text (verbatim): "Arcade", "SPDEV ARCADE", "SELECT YOUR GAME", "ASTEROIDS", "SNAKE", "BREAKOUT", "LIGHTS OUT", "PIXEL STUDIO", "BEAT LAB", "GRAVITY SLING", "PRISM RELAY", "PREVIEW", "Pilot your ship. Clear the field.", "START GAME", "SELECT", "START", "BACK", "01 / 08".
Constraints: preserve those eight real activities. No other game titles, Nintendo branding, famous characters, fake statistics, scores, online counts, achievements or prices. No dashboard, generic rounded cards, cyberpunk neon, purple glow, sci-fi holograms, desktop wallpaper clutter, physical room, tilted mockup, or explanatory annotations. One screen only. Do not print "concept B".
approval: User selected B and requested implementation on 2026-11-05.
